recorded.prompt:q-notify-dangling-else: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-notify-dangling-else: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-notify-dangling-else: Decided by section 'An else Belongs to the Nearest if': 'The grammar attaches an else to the nearest if that has none' and 'Indentation is for people'. So the else pairs with if (quietHours); for an opted-in user outside quiet hours the inner condition is false and the else runs askForConsent. The refund example ('delivered, not damaged: track parcel') shows the same case.
recorded.prompt:q-overdraft-definite-assignment: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-overdraft-definite-assignment: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-overdraft-definite-assignment: Decided by the Fee example (same shape: final blank local, if / else if with complementary non-constant conditions) and its error 'variable fee might not have been initialized', plus 'the definite-assignment rules evaluate only constant expressions, not what weightKg <= 5 means, so to javac both conditions can be false.' The quiz uses a String local instead of int; the page's rule is stated for any local, so the reader carries it over.
recorded.prompt:q-event-pattern-scope: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-event-pattern-scope: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-event-pattern-scope: Decided by 'A pattern variable introduced by a negated instanceof is in scope after the if when the if's body can't finish normally' and 'Replace the return -1 with a log line and return text.length() becomes error: cannot find symbol.' The quiz body only logs, so it does not compile. The option's wording ('the call can run for an event that is not an OrderPlaced') is the consequence of the body completing normally rather than the page's phrasing, but a reader gets there in one step.
recorded.prompt:q-audit-constant-flag: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-audit-constant-flag: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-audit-constant-flag: Decided by 'if (false) { ... } compiles, while while (false) { ... } is error: unreachable statement. The language exempts if on purpose, so that a constant flag can switch code off', the static final TRACE example where 'javap -c shows the body of handle as a single return', and the Reference row 'while (FLAG) with a constant false: error: unreachable statement'.

recorded.prompt:q-notify-dangling-else:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-notify-dangling-else:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-notify-dangling-else:a: Refuted: the grammar resolves the pairing ('attaches an else to the nearest if that has none') and 'javac compiles this without a warning, even with -Xlint:all'.
recorded.prompt:q-notify-dangling-else:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-notify-dangling-else:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-notify-dangling-else:b: Refuted: 'Indentation is for people'; the else binds to the nearest if, not the outer one. Summary: 'Indentation doesn't count; braces do.'
recorded.prompt:q-notify-dangling-else:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-notify-dangling-else:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-notify-dangling-else:d: Refuted: the refund example is the same shape (else after a nested brace-less if) and 'javac compiles this without a warning'; 'without braces the inner if (damaged) ... else ... is that statement'.
recorded.prompt:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:: Refuted: 'Every int passes one of the two conditions, but the definite-assignment rules evaluate only constant expressions', and the Fee example fails to compile.
recorded.prompt:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:: Refuted: 'Make the last branch a plain else and it compiles' (a final local with two assignment sites, one per branch, compiles), and 'Dropping final changes nothing: the error comes from reading a local that might be unassigned.'
recorded.prompt:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-overdraft-definite-assignment:: Refuted, by combining: 'the error comes from reading a local that might be unassigned' and 'A local declared without a value and assigned in every branch keeps a missing assignment a compile error.' Minor gap: the page shows this only for an int local and never says outright that a reference-type local gets no default null.

recorded.outcome:q-audit-constant-flag:b: Refuted: the page says the opposite. if (false) compiles, while (false)/while (FLAG) is 'error: unreachable statement'; the exemption is for if.
